## Continuation {#refs-two item="5"}

::: {.notes}
This is the shape both shipped templates use, and it is what a continuation page has to
be: a bare `## Title {item="N"}`. The explanation lives here, in a speaker note, because
a note is not a body -- `hasAuthoredBody` has to exclude `aside.notes` or this page stops
being recognised as a continuation page.
:::

## Last normal {#last-normal}
